title: AISO1 optimization tests (Radeon 8060S · llama.cpp Vulkan · the 4 current models)
source: David's ChatGPT session, 2026-11-18, from the llama.cpp and AMD documentation. A test order, not a proven speed ranking.
rule: Change one thing at a time; keep model SHA, NP, Input / Output, repeats, prompt and timing code fixed; report TTFT, TPOT, TPS Aggregate, TPS Normalized (equal at NP1).
order: 1 GPU offload + failure logs -> 2 F16 with Flash Attention on / off -> 3 every KV precision at the same Flash Attention setting

items.zh: 確認模型完整由 GPU 執行
items.now_en: --device Vulkan0 --n-gpu-layers 999 is set; the server logs at this level do not print the offloaded layers, so it is not verified per model yet
items.now_zh: 已設 --device Vulkan0 --n-gpu-layers 999；目前日誌層級沒印出各層卸載情形，尚未逐模型核實

items.now_en: Baseline is off. Test F16 KV with FA on, nothing else changed. With FA off, Gemma pads its V cache to 2048 (server log warning)
items.now_zh: 原基準為 off；先以 F16 KV 測 on/off，其他不變。FA off 時 Gemma 的 V cache 會被補到 2048（server.log 警告）
items.watch: TTFT at long Input · TPOT · memory

items.now_en: Running (FA off): f16 / bf16 / f32 start; all 24 quantized cases (q8_0, q5_0, q5_1, q4_0, q4_1, iq4_nl x 4 models) stop with 'quantized V cache requires flash_attn' - checked in every server.log. FP8 (f8_e4m3) is not in this build
items.now_zh: 進行中（FA off）：f16 / bf16 / f32 可啟動；量化 24 組全部因「量化 V cache 需要 Flash Attention」無法啟動（已逐一查 server.log）；此版本沒有 FP8

items.now_en: Baseline 1024 / 512; change one at a time. Bigger is not always faster
items.now_zh: 以 1024／512 為基準，一次改一項；較大不保證較快

items.zh: 並行 slots 與 context 容量
items.now_en: 10 slots, 18,432 context per request; measure NP1 / 2 / 4 and record the real KV allocation
items.now_zh: 10 slots、每請求 18,432；依 NP1／2／4 量測並記錄實際 KV 配置

items.now_en: The 4 GGUFs are already quantized; another weight file is another test group (new SHA) and needs an output-quality check
items.now_zh: 四個 GGUF 已量化；換權重＝另一組測試（SHA 不同），需驗證輸出品質

items.now_en: Only for repeated system prompts; keep cache_prompt=false as the baseline and test the cache separately
items.now_zh: 只適合重複前綴的情境；cache_prompt=false 保留作基準，另開實驗

items.now_en: Check 8060S / gfx1151, OS, driver and version support first; same GGUF and timing code. HIP is not assumed faster
items.now_zh: 先核對 8060S／gfx1151、OS、驅動與版本支援，再用相同 GGUF 與量測程式 A/B；不預設 HIP 較快

items.now_en: A small compatible draft model or n-gram; record the acceptance rate and extra memory. Can be slower
items.now_zh: 相容的小 draft model 或 n-gram；記錄接受率與額外記憶體，可能反而變慢

items.zh: 電源、溫度與 UMA 記憶體
items.now_en: Record power, temperature and memory split (AMD Strix Halo guide) before a controlled test; more BIOS GPU memory is not automatically faster
items.now_zh: 依 AMD Strix Halo 指引先記錄功率、溫度與記憶體配置再做受控測試；BIOS 多保留不等於加速
